audit.why: Gwen edges 1-2, level 3 is a skill window, Yi owns 4-5 through first item, Gwen reclaims 2+ items as the harder scaler. Full phases[].side and content win[] agree row-for-row and match the packet chart.
Four spikes placed at 3-5, level 6, first item and late, and breakdown.spikes correctly frames the race between her Riftmaker timing and your on-hit timing.
audit.corrected: Hallowed Mist 22s, Skip 'n Slash 13s and Snip Snip! 6.5s added so the windows are countable.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers state opposite things about Hallowed Mist. The full layer says Alpha Strike and your autos 'can't hit her inside it' and builds the entire all-in rule around waiting the mist out; the content layer says Alpha Strike lands inside it. Riot's text settles it: 'She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' The mist protects her from enemies outside it, so the answer is to step in — which is exactly what Alpha Strike does. Separately, A Thousand Cuts is called a 'passive shield' in whys[5] and spikes[2]; it is bonus magic damage plus a heal off champions, which makes Grievous Wounds the counter. Yi is again credited with lifesteal he does not have.
audit.why: This is the difference between an all-in that works and one that whiffs. Under the full layer's version you disengage and give her a free 22-second reset every time; under the correct version you walk into the mist and keep your entire kit online. Also worth stating: Snip Snip!'s centre deals true damage, so building resists is not the answer to her poke either.

edits.before: If you blow Alpha Strike and autos while she's untargetable in the mist, you deal zero damage and eat her counter — the single biggest way to throw this lane.
edits.after: If you stand outside the mist swinging, you deal zero damage and eat her counter — step in and she is targetable again, or wait the full 22s out.

edits.before: Alpha Strike makes you untargetable mid-blink, so you can use it to dodge incoming CC or to reposition out of where she expects you — but it cannot hit her while she sits inside Hallowed Mist. edits.after: Alpha Strike makes you untargetable mid-blink, so it dodges incoming CC and it carries you into Hallowed Mist — she can only be targeted from inside, so entering is the answer, not backing off.
